name: Sea Food
description: Farmer's Delight add-ons that cook fish and sea mobs.

pages.title: Sea Food
pages.text: Two [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]() add-ons cook the ocean. They use Farmer's Delight's pot, cutting board and knives, so meals follow the same rules as the rest of the pack's food.

- **Ocean's Delight** cooks vanilla ocean mobs: squid, cod, kelp, sea pickles, pufferfish, guardians and even Elder Guardians.
- **Aquaculture Delight** cooks [#](2E5AAC)[Aquaculture](entry://fishing/aquaculture)[#]()'s fish: perch, halibut, pollock, tuna, catfish, bass and turtle meat. They are caught on any rod.

pages.title: Guardian Soup
pages.text: A one-pot soup made from Guardian parts.

pages.title: Stuffed Squid
pages.text: Squid meals. Cut Tentacles and Squid Rings come from cutting squid.

pages.title: Fish and Chips
pages.text: Aquaculture Delight meals use fillets and fish. Also includes a Neptunium Knife.

pages.title: Neptunium Knife
pages.text: A Farmer's Delight style knife made with Neptunium, for cutting fish.

Fillets from the cutting board or the [#](2E5AAC)[Cleaning Table](entry://fishing/cleaning)[#]() go into these meals, so every catch can: [#](2E5AAC)[What Fish Are For](entry://fishing/fish_uses)[#]().\
\
The same fish also feed automated kitchens: see [#](2E5AAC)[Kitchen Automation](entry://food/kitchen_automation)[#](). Hybrid Aquatic's clams cook into Cooked Clam, and Naturalist's clams give Clam Meat.
